A diamond in the rough
Feb 2026 • Couples
We fancied a change from the usual Vietnamese breakfasts, so we thought we’d give this place a try. Going by the great reviews,we hoped it would meet our expectations. 
Located toward the end of a not so attractive dead end street, we were unsure if we were in the right place. Don't be put off, it’s a popular spot and the food is awesome! 
The cafe seating areas are on two floors. We settled for the air conditioned ground, rather that open air dining at that time of the morning, as it was hot! 🥵
My wife ordered avocado, scrambled eggs on sourdough bread plus a banana and mango smoothies. As I wasn’t that hungry, really fancied a bacon sandwich, but it seems as it’s not on the menu, we have go from the dishes listed. So I went for smoked salmon and scrambled eggs and Yorkshire tea. 
Each of the plates we ordered were huge! Far too much food for us, but it would appeal to those with a bigger appetite. 
The food was lovely, but we hardly got through half of it. Mine came with half an avocado (yuk) and tomato, which went on my wife’s plate as I’m not a lover of either item. 
We were stuffed and felt a little guilty leaving so much food on the plate. It was one the most expensive breakfasts we’ve had so far in Vietnam (604,000 VND, about £17.00 for the two meals) but it was worth it. 
They have numerous English dishes and they take cash or card. We used our MasterCard for which they added 1.5%, cheap for Vietnam. 
Don’t be put off by the street location, it’s a diamond in the rough. Give a try,I’m sure you’ll be glad you did.

Amazing Breakfast and Brunch Restaurant/Cafe
Aug 2025 • Couples
Have been to this local Cafe/Restaurant a couple of times, and my impression is the same each time I come here.....Fantastic!!

From the Coffee's to the Smoothie Bowls (Thai equivalent of an Acai Bowl), and full on breakfast options, smoothies, health drinks, wines and spirits, you cannot go amiss. Add the amazing 2 storey decor with a central open sky view, a/c, Koi Pond, comfy seating, and "classy" background music (Billy Joel, Lionel Ritchie, James Taylor etc), and you have locale that you can sit in for an hour easily just "chillin".

No place would be a great business without its staff, and the staff here are just wonderful (sorry for not posting names...my bad). Polite, attentive (but do not loiter), and always have a smile for you!!

They do accept credit cards, and they also have wifi (so you can login and leave your own post here on tripadvisor...lol)

Amazing hidden gem for brunch!
Jun 2025 • Couples
This place was a little difficult to find… walk down an alleyway which looks pretty run down and near the end you are faced with a beautiful shop front… The food was amazing 🤩 and in abundance! 
I had the vegetarian breakfast and my husband had the salmon eggs Benedict both of which were yum! 😋 
We also enjoyed a cocktail 🍸 as it was my husbands birthday 🎂 
The restaurant itself is beautifully decorated and has very comfortable seating! Downstairs it is air conditioned with ceiling fans and upstairs is open air. 
A must visit for breakfast, brunch or anytime really! 🥰
